memory_candidates.content: When a validate-artifact.sh-style test suite's $VALIDATE variable resolves deploy-tree-first (checking .claude/scripts/... before the agent-system/extensions/.../scripts/ source-store sibling), new fixtures covering a just-written source-store check will silently test a stale deployed binary unless they explicitly invoke the source-store path instead. Pattern: add a second variable (e.g. VALIDATE_SRC) pointing directly at "$SCRIPT_DIR/../<script>.sh" for use only by the new fixtures, leaving the shared deploy-tree-first variable untouched for every pre-existing case.

In a bash validator pipeline, never chain `grep -n ...` into a later step that extracts the first digit from the matched text with `grep -oE '[0-9]+' | head -1` -- the -n line-number prefix itself contains a digit and will be mistakenly picked up as the real value instead of the digit inside the actual content. Drop -n from any grep stage that feeds digit/number extraction downstream; only use -n when the line number itself is needed.
